verses.original: Ἀνὴρ δέ τις Ἁνανίας ὀνόματι σὺν Σαπφίρῃ τῇ γυναικὶ αὐτοῦ ἐπώλησεν κτῆμα
verses.transliteration: Anēr de tis Hananias onomati syn Sapphirē tē gynaiki autou epōlēsen ktēma
verses.literal: Now a man named Ananias together with his wife Sapphira also sold a piece of property

verses.original: καὶ ἐνοσφίσατο ἀπὸ τῆς τιμῆς συνειδυίης καὶ τῆς γυναικός καὶ ἐνέγκας μέρος τι παρὰ τοὺς πόδας τῶν ἀποστόλων ἔθηκεν
verses.transliteration: kai enosphisato apo tēs timēs syneiduiēs kai tēs gynaikos kai enenkas meros ti para tous podas tōn apostolōn ethēken
verses.literal: With . . . his wife’s full knowledge he kept back some of the proceeds for himself but brought a portion and laid it at the apostles’ feet

verses.original: Εἶπεν δὲ ὁ Πέτρος Ἁνανία διὰ τί ἐπλήρωσεν ὁ Σατανᾶς τὴν καρδίαν σου ψεύσασθαί σε τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ Ἅγιον καὶ νοσφίσασθαι ἀπὸ τῆς τιμῆς τοῦ χωρίου
verses.transliteration: Eipen de ho Petros Hanania dia ti eplērōsen ho Satanas tēn kardian sou pseusasthai se to Pneuma to Hagion kai nosphisasthai apo tēs timēs tou chōriou
verses.literal: Then Peter said Ananias how is it that . . . Satan has filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit and withhold some of the proceeds from the land

verses.original: οὐχὶ μένον σοὶ ἔμενεν καὶ πραθὲν ἐν τῇ σῇ ἐξουσίᾳ ὑπῆρχεν τί ὅτι ἔθου ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ σου τὸ πρᾶγμα τοῦτο οὐκ ἐψεύσω ἀνθρώποις ἀλλὰ τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: ouchi menon soi emenen kai prathen en tē sē exousia hypērchen ti hoti ethou en tē kardia sou to pragma touto ouk epseusō anthrōpois alla tō Theō
verses.literal: Did it not belong to you before it was sold And after it was sold was it not at your disposal How could you conceive such a deed in your heart You have not lied to men but to God

verses.original: Ἀκούων δὲ ὁ Ἁνανίας τοὺς λόγους τούτους πεσὼν ἐξέψυξεν καὶ ἐγένετο φόβος μέγας ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς ἀκούοντας
verses.transliteration: Akouōn de ho Hananias tous logous toutous pesōn exepsyxen kai egeneto phobos megas epi pantas tous akouontas
verses.literal: On hearing these words Ananias fell down and died And great fear came over all who heard what had happened

verses.original: ἀναστάντες δὲ οἱ νεώτεροι συνέστειλαν αὐτὸν καὶ ἐξενέγκαντες ἔθαψαν
verses.transliteration: anastantes de hoi neōteroi synesteilan auton kai exenenkantes ethapsan
verses.literal: Then the young men stepped forward wrapped up his body and carried him out and buried him

verses.original: Ἐγένετο δὲ ὡς ὡρῶν τριῶν διάστημα καὶ ἡ γυνὴ αὐτοῦ μὴ εἰδυῖα τὸ γεγονὸς εἰσῆλθεν
verses.transliteration: Egeneto de hōs hōrōn triōn diastēma kai hē gynē autou mē eiduia to gegonos eisēlthen
verses.literal: About three hours later his wife also came in unaware of what had happened

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθη δὲ πρὸς αὐτὴν Πέτρος Εἰπέ μοι εἰ τοσούτου τὸ χωρίον ἀπέδοσθε Ἡ δὲ εἶπεν Ναί τοσούτου
verses.transliteration: apekrithē de pros autēn Petros Eipe moi ei tosoutou to chōrion apedosthe Hē de eipen Nai tosoutou
verses.literal: Tell me said Peter - is this the price you and your husband got for the land Yes - she answered that is the price

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Πέτρος πρὸς αὐτήν Τί ὅτι συνεφωνήθη ὑμῖν πειράσαι τὸ Πνεῦμα Κυρίου ἰδοὺ οἱ πόδες τῶν θαψάντων τὸν ἄνδρα σου ἐπὶ τῇ θύρᾳ καὶ ἐξοίσουσίν σε
verses.transliteration: Ho de Petros pros autēn Ti hoti synephōnēthē hymin peirasai to Pneuma Kyriou idou hoi podes tōn thapsantōn ton andra sou epi tē thyra kai exoisousin se
verses.literal: How could you agree to test the Spirit of the Lord - Peter replied - Look the feet of the men who buried your husband are at the door and they will carry you out also . . .

verses.original: Ἔπεσεν δὲ παραχρῆμα πρὸς τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐξέψυξεν εἰσελθόντες δὲ οἱ νεανίσκοι εὗρον αὐτὴν νεκράν καὶ ἐξενέγκαντες ἔθαψαν πρὸς τὸν ἄνδρα αὐτῆς
verses.transliteration: Epesen de parachrēma pros tous podas autou kai exepsyxen eiselthontes de hoi neaniskoi heuron autēn nekran kai exenenkantes ethapsan pros ton andra autēs
verses.literal: At that instant she fell down at his feet and died Then the young men came in and finding her dead carried her out and buried her beside her husband

verses.original: Καὶ ἐγένετο φόβος μέγας ἐφ’ ὅλην τὴν ἐκκλησίαν καὶ ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς ἀκούοντας ταῦτα
verses.transliteration: Kai egeneto phobos megas eph’ holēn tēn ekklēsian kai epi pantas tous akouontas tauta
verses.literal: And great fear came over the whole church and all who heard about these events

verses.original: Διὰ δὲ τῶν χειρῶν τῶν ἀποστόλων ἐγίνετο σημεῖα καὶ τέρατα πολλὰ ἐν τῷ λαῷ καὶ ἦσαν ὁμοθυμαδὸν ἅπαντες ἐν τῇ στοᾷ Σολομῶντος
verses.transliteration: Dia de tōn cheirōn tōn apostolōn egineto sēmeia kai terata polla en tō laō kai ēsan homothymadon hapantes en tē stoa Solomōntos
verses.literal: The apostles performed many signs and wonders among the people and with one accord the believers gathered together . . . in Solomon’s Colonnade

verses.original: τῶν δὲ λοιπῶν οὐδεὶς ἐτόλμα κολλᾶσθαι αὐτοῖς ἀλλ’ ἐμεγάλυνεν αὐτοὺς ὁ λαός
verses.transliteration: tōn de loipōn oudeis etolma kollasthai autois all’ emegalynen autous ho laos
verses.literal: Although the people regarded them highly . . . no one else dared to join them

verses.original: μᾶλλον δὲ προσετίθεντο πιστεύοντες τῷ Κυρίῳ πλήθη ἀνδρῶν τε καὶ γυναικῶν
verses.transliteration: mallon de prosetithento pisteuontes tō Kyriō plēthē andrōn te kai gynaikōn
verses.literal: Yet more and more believers were brought to the Lord large numbers of both men and women

verses.original: ὥστε καὶ εἰς τὰς πλατείας ἐκφέρειν τοὺς ἀσθενεῖς καὶ τιθέναι ἐπὶ κλιναρίων καὶ κραβάττων ἵνα ἐρχομένου Πέτρου κἂν ἡ σκιὰ ἐπισκιάσῃ τινὶ αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: hōste kai eis tas plateias ekpherein tous astheneis kai tithenai epi klinariōn kai krabattōn hina erchomenou Petrou kan hē skia episkiasē tini autōn
verses.literal: As a result people brought the sick into the streets and laid them on cots and mats so that at least Peter’s shadow might fall on some of them as he passed by

verses.original: συνήρχετο δὲ καὶ τὸ πλῆθος τῶν πέριξ πόλεων Ἰερουσαλήμ φέροντες ἀσθενεῖς καὶ ὀχλουμένους ὑπὸ πνευμάτων ἀκαθάρτων οἵτινες ἐθεραπεύοντο ἅπαντες
verses.transliteration: synērcheto de kai to plēthos tōn perix poleōn Ierousalēm pherontes astheneis kai ochloumenous hypo pneumatōn akathartōn hoitines etherapeuonto hapantes
verses.literal: Crowds also gathered from the towns around Jerusalem bringing the sick and those tormented by unclean spirits and all of them were healed

verses.original: Ἀναστὰς δὲ ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς καὶ πάντες οἱ σὺν αὐτῷ ἡ οὖσα αἵρεσις τῶν Σαδδουκαίων ἐπλήσθησαν ζήλου
verses.transliteration: Anastas de ho archiereus kai pantes hoi syn autō hē ousa hairesis tōn Saddoukaiōn eplēsthēsan zēlou
verses.literal: Then the high priest and all his associates . . . . . . who belonged to the party of the Sadducees were filled with jealousy They went out

verses.original: καὶ ἐπέβαλον τὰς χεῖρας ἐπὶ τοὺς ἀποστόλους καὶ ἔθεντο αὐτοὺς ἐν τηρήσει δημοσίᾳ
verses.transliteration: kai epebalon tas cheiras epi tous apostolous kai ethento autous en tērēsei dēmosia
verses.literal: and arrested . . . . . . . . . the apostles and put them in the public jail

verses.original: Ἄγγελος δὲ Κυρίου διὰ νυκτὸς ἤνοιξε τὰς θύρας τῆς φυλακῆς ἐξαγαγών τε αὐτοὺς εἶπεν
verses.transliteration: Angelos de Kyriou dia nyktos ēnoixe tas thyras tēs phylakēs exagagōn te autous eipen
verses.literal: But during the night an angel of the Lord opened the doors of the jail and brought them out saying

verses.original: Πορεύεσθε καὶ σταθέντες λαλεῖτε ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ τῷ λαῷ πάντα τὰ ῥήματα τῆς Ζωῆς ταύτης
verses.transliteration: Poreuesthe kai stathentes laleite en tō hierō tō laō panta ta rhēmata tēs Zōēs tautēs
verses.literal: Go stand in the temple courts and tell the people the full message of this new life

verses.original: Ἀκούσαντες δὲ εἰσῆλθον ὑπὸ τὸν ὄρθρον εἰς τὸ ἱερὸν καὶ ἐδίδασκον Παραγενόμενος δὲ ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς καὶ οἱ σὺν αὐτῷ συνεκάλεσαν τὸ συνέδριον καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γερουσίαν τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ καὶ ἀπέστειλαν εἰς τὸ δεσμωτήριον ἀχθῆναι αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: Akousantes de eisēlthon hypo ton orthron eis to hieron kai edidaskon Paragenomenos de ho archiereus kai hoi syn autō synekalesan to synedrion kai pasan tēn gerousian tōn huiōn Israēl kai apesteilan eis to desmōtērion achthēnai autous
verses.literal: At daybreak the apostles entered . . . the temple courts as they had been told and began to teach the people When the high priest and his associates . . . . . . arrived they convened the Sanhedrin the full assembly of the elders of Israel and sent to the jail for the apostles

verses.original: οἱ δὲ παραγενόμενοι ὑπηρέται οὐχ εὗρον αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ φυλακῇ ἀναστρέψαντες δὲ ἀπήγγειλαν
verses.transliteration: hoi de paragenomenoi hypēretai ouch heuron autous en tē phylakē anastrepsantes de apēngeilan
verses.literal: But on arriving at the jail the officers did not find them there So they returned with the report

verses.original: λέγοντες ὅτι Τὸ δεσμωτήριον εὕρομεν κεκλεισμένον ἐν πάσῃ ἀσφαλείᾳ καὶ τοὺς φύλακας ἑστῶτας ἐπὶ τῶν θυρῶν ἀνοίξαντες δὲ ἔσω οὐδένα εὕρομεν
verses.transliteration: legontes hoti To desmōtērion heuromen kekleismenon en pasē asphaleia kai tous phylakas hestōtas epi tōn thyrōn anoixantes de esō oudena heuromen
verses.literal: We found the jail securely locked with the guards posted at the doors but when we opened them we found no one inside

verses.original: Ὡς δὲ ἤκουσαν τοὺς λόγους τούτους ὅ τε στρατηγὸς τοῦ ἱεροῦ καὶ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς διηπόρουν περὶ αὐτῶν τί ἂν γένοιτο τοῦτο
verses.transliteration: Hōs de ēkousan tous logous toutous ho te stratēgos tou hierou kai hoi archiereis diēporoun peri autōn ti an genoito touto
verses.literal: When the captain of the temple guard and the chief priests heard this account they were perplexed as to . . . what . . . was happening

verses.original: παραγενόμενος δέ τις ἀπήγγειλεν αὐτοῖς ὅτι Ἰδοὺ οἱ ἄνδρες οὓς ἔθεσθε ἐν τῇ φυλακῇ εἰσὶν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ ἑστῶτες καὶ διδάσκοντες τὸν λαόν
verses.transliteration: paragenomenos de tis apēngeilen autois hoti Idou hoi andres hous ethesthe en tē phylakē eisin en tō hierō hestōtes kai didaskontes ton laon
verses.literal: Then someone came in and announced - Look the men you put in jail are standing in the temple courts teaching the people

verses.original: Τότε ἀπελθὼν ὁ στρατηγὸς σὺν τοῖς ὑπηρέταις ἦγεν αὐτούς οὐ μετὰ βίας ἐφοβοῦντο γὰρ τὸν λαόν μὴ λιθασθῶσιν
verses.transliteration: Tote apelthōn ho stratēgos syn tois hypēretais ēgen autous ou meta bias ephobounto gar ton laon mē lithasthōsin
verses.literal: At that point the captain went with the officers and brought the apostles but not by force for fear the people would stone them

verses.original: ἀγαγόντες δὲ αὐτοὺς ἔστησαν ἐν τῷ συνεδρίῳ καὶ ἐπηρώτησεν αὐτοὺς ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς
verses.transliteration: agagontes de autous estēsan en tō synedriō kai epērōtēsen autous ho archiereus
verses.literal: They brought them in . . . and made them stand before the Sanhedrin where the high priest interrogated them

verses.original: λέγων Οὐ Παραγγελίᾳ παρηγγείλαμεν ὑμῖν μὴ διδάσκειν ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι τούτῳ καὶ ἰδοὺ πεπληρώκατε τὴν Ἰερουσαλὴμ τῆς διδαχῆς ὑμῶν καὶ βούλεσθε ἐπαγαγεῖν ἐφ’ ἡμᾶς τὸ αἷμα τοῦ ἀνθρώπου τούτου
verses.transliteration: legōn Ou Parangelia parēngeilamen hymin mē didaskein epi tō onomati toutō kai idou peplērōkate tēn Ierousalēm tēs didachēs hymōn kai boulesthe epagagein eph’ hēmas to haima tou anthrōpou toutou
verses.literal: We gave you strict orders . . . . . . not to teach in this name he said Yet . . . you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching and are determined to make us responsible for . . . . . . this man’s blood

verses.original: Ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ Πέτρος καὶ οἱ ἀπόστολοι εἶπαν Πειθαρχεῖν δεῖ Θεῷ μᾶλλον ἢ ἀνθρώποις
verses.transliteration: Apokritheis de Petros kai hoi apostoloi eipan Peitharchein dei Theō mallon ē anthrōpois
verses.literal: But Peter and the other apostles replied . . . We must obey God rather than men

verses.original: ὁ Θεὸς τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν ἤγειρεν Ἰησοῦν ὃν ὑμεῖς διεχειρίσασθε κρεμάσαντες ἐπὶ ξύλου
verses.transliteration: ho Theos tōn paterōn hēmōn ēgeiren Iēsoun hon hymeis diecheirisasthe kremasantes epi xylou
verses.literal: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus whom you had killed by hanging Him on a tree

verses.original: τοῦτον ὁ Θεὸς Ἀρχηγὸν καὶ Σωτῆρα ὕψωσεν τῇ δεξιᾷ αὐτοῦ τοῦ δοῦναι μετάνοιαν τῷ Ἰσραὴλ καὶ ἄφεσιν ἁμαρτιῶν
verses.transliteration: touton ho Theos Archēgon kai Sōtēra hypsōsen tē dexia autou tou dounai metanoian tō Israēl kai aphesin hamartiōn
verses.literal: God exalted Him to His right hand as Prince and Savior in order to grant repentance and forgiveness of sins to Israel

verses.original: καὶ ἡμεῖς ἐσμεν μάρτυρες τῶν ῥημάτων τούτων καὶ τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ Ἅγιον ὃ ἔδωκεν ὁ Θεὸς τοῖς πειθαρχοῦσιν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: kai hēmeis esmen martyres tōn rhēmatōn toutōn kai to Pneuma to Hagion ho edōken ho Theos tois peitharchousin autō
verses.literal: We are witnesses of these things and so is the Holy Spirit whom God has given to those who obey Him

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ ἀκούσαντες διεπρίοντο καὶ ἐβουλεύοντο ἀνελεῖν αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: Hoi de akousantes dieprionto kai ebouleuonto anelein autous
verses.literal: When the Council members heard this they were enraged and they resolved to put the apostles to death . . .

verses.original: Ἀναστὰς δέ τις ἐν τῷ συνεδρίῳ Φαρισαῖος ὀνόματι Γαμαλιήλ νομοδιδάσκαλος τίμιος παντὶ τῷ λαῷ ἐκέλευσεν ἔξω βραχὺ τοὺς ἀνθρώπους ποιῆσαι
verses.transliteration: Anastas de tis en tō synedriō Pharisaios onomati Gamaliēl nomodidaskalos timios panti tō laō ekeleusen exō brachy tous anthrōpous poiēsai
verses.literal: But a Pharisee named Gamaliel a teacher of the law who was honored by all the people stood up in the Sanhedrin and ordered that the men be put outside for a short time

verses.original: Εἶπέν τε πρὸς αὐτούς Ἄνδρες Ἰσραηλῖται προσέχετε ἑαυτοῖς ἐπὶ τοῖς ἀνθρώποις τούτοις τί μέλλετε πράσσειν
verses.transliteration: Eipen te pros autous Andres Israēlitai prosechete heautois epi tois anthrōpois toutois ti mellete prassein
verses.literal: Men of Israel he said - consider carefully . . . what you are about to do to these men

verses.original: πρὸ γὰρ τούτων τῶν ἡμερῶν ἀνέστη Θευδᾶς λέγων εἶναί τινα ἑαυτόν ᾧ προσεκλίθη ἀνδρῶν ἀριθμὸς ὡς τετρακοσίων ὃς ἀνῃρέθη καὶ πάντες ὅσοι ἐπείθοντο αὐτῷ διελύθησαν καὶ ἐγένοντο εἰς οὐδέν
verses.transliteration: pro gar toutōn tōn hēmerōn anestē Theudas legōn einai tina heauton hō proseklithē andrōn arithmos hōs tetrakosiōn hos anērethē kai pantes hosoi epeithonto autō dielythēsan kai egenonto eis ouden
verses.literal: Some time ago . . . . . . . . . Theudas rose up claiming . . . to be somebody and about four hundred men joined him He was killed all his followers . . . . . . were dispersed and it all came to nothing

verses.original: μετὰ τοῦτον ἀνέστη Ἰούδας ὁ Γαλιλαῖος ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις τῆς ἀπογραφῆς καὶ ἀπέστησεν λαὸν ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ κἀκεῖνος ἀπώλετο καὶ πάντες ὅσοι ἐπείθοντο αὐτῷ διεσκορπίσθησαν
verses.transliteration: meta touton anestē Ioudas ho Galilaios en tais hēmerais tēs apographēs kai apestēsen laon opisō autou kakeinos apōleto kai pantes hosoi epeithonto autō dieskorpisthēsan
verses.literal: After him Judas the Galilean appeared in the days of the census and drew away people after him He too perished and all his followers . . . . . . were scattered

verses.original: Καὶ τὰ νῦν λέγω ὑμῖν ἀπόστητε ἀπὸ τῶν ἀνθρώπων τούτων καὶ ἄφετε αὐτούς ὅτι ἐὰν ᾖ ἐξ ἀνθρώπων ἡ βουλὴ αὕτη ἢ τὸ ἔργον τοῦτο καταλυθήσεται
verses.transliteration: Kai ta nyn legō hymin apostēte apo tōn anthrōpōn toutōn kai aphete autous hoti ean ē ex anthrōpōn hē boulē hautē ē to ergon touto katalythēsetai
verses.literal: So in the present case I advise you Leave . . . these men alone Let them go . . . For if their purpose or - endeavor is of human origin it will fail

verses.original: εἰ δὲ ἐκ Θεοῦ ἐστιν οὐ δυνήσεσθε καταλῦσαι αὐτούς μή‿ ποτε καὶ θεομάχοι εὑρεθῆτε
verses.transliteration: ei de ek Theou estin ou dynēsesthe katalysai autous mē pote kai theomachoi heurethēte
verses.literal: But if it is from God you will not be able to stop them You may even find yourselves fighting against God

verses.original: Ἐπείσθησαν δὲ αὐτῷ καὶ προσκαλεσάμενοι τοὺς ἀποστόλους δείραντες παρήγγειλαν μὴ λαλεῖν ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ Ἰησοῦ καὶ ἀπέλυσαν
verses.transliteration: Epeisthēsan de autō kai proskalesamenoi tous apostolous deirantes parēngeilan mē lalein epi tō onomati tou Iēsou kai apelysan
verses.literal: At this they yielded to Gamaliel They called the apostles in and had them flogged Then they ordered them not to speak in the name of Jesus and released them

verses.original: Οἱ μὲν οὖν ἐπορεύοντο χαίροντες ἀπὸ προσώπου τοῦ συνεδρίου ὅτι κατηξιώθησαν ὑπὲρ τοῦ Ὀνόματος ἀτιμασθῆναι
verses.transliteration: Hoi men oun eporeuonto chairontes apo prosōpou tou synedriou hoti katēxiōthēsan hyper tou Onomatos atimasthēnai
verses.literal: The apostles left . . . . . . the Sanhedrin rejoicing that they had been counted worthy of suffering disgrace for the Name

verses.original: πᾶσάν τε ἡμέραν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ καὶ κατ’ οἶκον οὐκ ἐπαύοντο διδάσκοντες καὶ εὐαγγελιζόμενοι τὸν Χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν
verses.transliteration: pasan te hēmeran en tō hierō kai kat’ oikon ouk epauonto didaskontes kai euangelizomenoi ton Christon Iēsoun
verses.literal: Every day in the temple courts and from house to house they did not stop teaching and proclaiming the good news that Jesus is the Christ
